operationOrder: DR01 through DR12; each is a separate measurement cell
parameterSchedule: parameterAt(caseId, ordinal, scale); ordinal starts at 0 per phase and increases per dispatched operation; never replay validation.ndjson as a performance schedule

warmup.rule: last 3 window p50 values max/min <= 1.10; otherwise unstable; do not extend selectively

resetBetweenVariants: same immutable imported dataset; new client connections; same specified cache procedure and warmup; no overlap with another cell

validation.preAndPost: all 192 published validation vectors against the imported graph
validation.measuredSample: every operation whose per-case ordinal modulo 1000 equals 0, plus every HTTP/protocol error; record sampled result evidence after the timed consumption boundary
validation.assertionsOnEveryOperation: status, complete body, legal envelope, expected response type, no truncation or cursor loop

timing: monotonic dispatch through complete response body and declared decoding/normalization; all pages included; oracle comparison and evidence writing separately timed and disclosed
metricUnavailablePolicy: mark unavailable and invalidate any verdict depending on it; never substitute zero

comparison.unit: paired independent block, never individual requests
comparison.effect: geometric mean of per-block candidate/baseline ratios, separately by case/scale/cache/concurrency/topology/route
comparison.pilotVerdict: descriptive-only until A/A and injected-regression calibration passes
comparison.suiteWideGate: disabled until a multiple-comparison policy has been calibrated

backgroundState: record compaction, flush, snapshot, rebalance, Raft and GC continuously; stable-state requires no planned writes or rebalancing; disturbed-state runs use a separately versioned workload
